name: BITEZ - Triple-Stacked 2,000MG Gummies - Bomb Pop - Limited Edition
description:
Ocho Extracts' exclusive drop is here — meet Bomb Pop TRIPLE-Stacked Bitez, our most stacked gummies yet. Each limited-edition 2-count bag delivers 1,000mg per gummy with a powerful blend of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP. Bursting with nostalgic Bomb Pop flavor (Cherry, Lime, Blue Razz), these high-potency edibles won’t be in stock long so get yours now!

Bomb Pop stacks three bold layers of Cherry, Lime, and Blue Razz flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
